title: Chicago Truborn

services.name: Event Space Rental
services.desc: The gallery showcases local/street/graffiti/urban artists from the Chicago area, creating a funky, colorful, and eclectic atmosphere with ever changing decor. Our murals provide exciting and unique backgrounds for event pictures and add to the exciting nature of the space. Additional features of the venue are wifi access, air conditioning, and the option to use a 100″ projection screen. Street parking is plentiful in the area. The space is ideal for private parties, fundraisers, and film screenings. If you are looking for a non traditional venue with a lot of personality, this is the spot for you! Unfortunately we are not able to accommodate art exhibits or events where wall space is needed
